entries.text: Make a single tart berry taste sweet.

entries.text: Braid the hair of a girl by softly blowing over it.

entries.text: Command a broom to sweep a room, up to 300 sq. feet.

entries.text: Change casters eye colour to [Color.eye]; normal colour reappears after 10 * 1d6 minutes.

entries.text: Single out a single bee, wasp or mosquito. Caster cannot be stung by it, as long as caster keeps the insect in sight.

entries.text: Coil up to 10 ft of rope, provided the rope does not have knots, isn't tied to something and no one is holding it.

entries.text: Once an hour, can make a single copper coin disappear.

entries.text: Increase one cup of water one notch in temperature (cold to chilly; chilly to room temperature; room temperature to lukewarm; lukewarm to warm; warm to hot; hot to boiling). One increased, a cup cannot increase to another level.
